Game Overview

Acorn Bot is a adventure title where guide a charming robot through eight exhilarating levels, collecting ice cream while evading enemy bots and treacherous traps. Master the double jump to outwit rotating lasers and perilous spikes in this captivating 2D platformer. Precision and strategic planning are your keys to victory!

Playing Acorn Bot comes down to a simple loop. Guide a charming robot through eight exhilarating levels, collecting ice cream while evading enemy bots and treacherous traps. Master the double jump to outwit rotating lasers and perilous spikes in this captivating 2D platformer. Precision and strategic planning are your keys to victory!
